name: cloud
notes: Domain-warped cloud: the soft cumulus spectrum resampled through a low-frequency displacement - advected billows. The un-warped variant lives on in this spec's history; the warped field won review as the more cloud-like. Levels 30/55/80 = light/medium/heavy, calibrated to core-band stroke coverage by tools/fractal-tip.mjs --calibrate; verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
